title: Venetian Pasta Bowl
description: A warm and comforting penne pasta dish inspired by Venezuelan flavors, perfect for a cozy meal.

ingredients.name: roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and zucchini

instructions: Cook the penne pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large bowl, toss the roasted vegetables with olive oil, salt, and pepper until well coated.
Add the cooked black beans, vegan cheese shreds, and cooked penne pasta to the bowl.
Toss everything together until well combined.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
